title: Rabbi Chanina ben Pazai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Seder HaDorot cites him from Yuchasin, saying, “I did not find him.” Hyman says that it should in fact read ben Padai. Nachal Eden, page 92b, says Chanina ben Padai appears at the end of Tosefta Eduyot; the ordinary reading there is Rabbi Chananyah bar Ado, while Zuckermandel’s Tosefta has bar Adai.

notes.text: The phrase מיוחסין means from Yuchasin. Pazai, Padai, Chananyah bar Ado and bar Adai are retained as the notice’s readings, rather than normalized into one form.

The consulted Machon Mamre Tosefta Eduyot 3:4 reads Rabbi Chananyah ben Ado, whereas Hyman reports bar Ado as his ordinary reading. The Nachal Eden and Zuckermandel readings are cited here from Hyman.
